Regarding Rand's sealing of the Bore, I believe the statement at the end of the article about him creating new threads in the Pattern to re-seal the hole is basically correct.  Lews Therin's attempt failed because he tried to seal the Bore using only ''Saidin.''  Because of that he could only create a temporary patch over the hole but not actually repair the hole in the Pattern, which could only be done by using ''Saidin'' <u>and</u> ''Saidar,'' <u>both</u> halves of the True Source that drives the Wheel of Time.  As to whether the Pattern itself is the Dark One's prison I don't know, but since the Dark One is described as being locked outside the Pattern it could make sense to say that.
